raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.27.1"
  build: 5

recipe:
  name: go-${{ go_variant_str }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://dl.google.com/go/go${{ version }}.src.tar.gz
    sha256: 4e408abae126d916b6164627193f2c54f0e3ca1312d693b86db45f862ab238b1
    target_directory: go
    patches:
      # Please see patches/README.md for more details
      - patches/0001-Fix-cgo_fortran-test-setup-for-conda.patch
      - patches/0002-Add-CC-C-CPP-LD-FLAGS-to-script_test-extraEnvKeys.patch
      - patches/0003-Inherit-CGO_-environment-variables.patch
      - patches/0004-Add-conda-aware-default-values-for-GOPATH-and-GOBIN.patch
      - patches/0005-cmd-link-internal-ld-disable-testWindowsBuildmodeCSh.patch
      - patches/0006-Revert-cmd-link-enable-internal-linker-in-more-cases.patch
      - patches/0007-Mark-ftree-as-a-safe-compiler-flag.patch
      - patches/0008-Mark-merge-constants-as-a-safe-compiler-flag.patch
      - patches/0009-Mark-conda-s-linker-flags-as-safe-for-internal-link.patch

  # Update this with a release from https://go.dev/dl/
  - if: build_platform == "linux-64"
    then:
      url: https://go.dev/dl/go${{ version }}.linux-amd64.tar.gz
      sha256: 63d339f0da5ab53635a56f2490a7984dfe12dfcff22ad749f63edaf590168445
      target_directory: go-bootstrap
  - if: build_platform == "linux-aarch64"
    then:
      url: https://go.dev/dl/go${{ version }}.linux-arm64.tar.gz
      sha256: 3450b45a3f9ee8568792736a5c5e70a1f2e9b36c35a8f74958c03e51d7d92bec
      target_directory: go-bootstrap
  - if: build_platform == "win-64"
    then:
      url: https://go.dev/dl/go${{ version }}.windows-amd64.zip
      sha256: a3911b5e0e1b1053f25ed0675f4c1c6aad1e2bfcf253df2b9be4caabd2edd95d
      target_directory: go-bootstrap
  - if: build_platform == "osx-64"
    then:
      url: https://go.dev/dl/go${{ version }}.darwin-amd64.tar.gz
      sha256: 8f8f52c6649542cf027bbc9b9c68d1ec042f9f34808a40413f0b8b3f66f3caa4
      target_directory: go-bootstrap
  - if: build_platform == "osx-arm64"
    then:
      url: https://go.dev/dl/go${{ version }}.darwin-arm64.tar.gz
      sha256: ee215d57e0ec269c60cc9ceca68e6bda321ba9ee5afe24f4b0988703c2d87d12
      target_directory: go-bootstrap

build:
  number: ${{ build }}

outputs:
  - package:
      name: go
    build:
      string: ${{ go_variant_str }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build }}
      script:
        file: ${{ go_variant_str }}/build
      dynamic_linking:
        binary_relocation: false
      prefix_detection:
        ignore_binary_files: true
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: unix and cgo
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - if: win and cgo
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ compiler('m2w64_cxx') }}
            - ${{ compiler('m2w64_fortran') }}
      run_constraints:
        # TODO: remove on next go version (>1.27.1), this is just to not accidentally select the wrong activation script
        - _go_select <0.0a0
        # https://github.com/prefix-dev/rattler-build/issues/2792
        - if: unix and cgo
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - if: win and cgo
          then:
            - ${{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('m2w64_cxx') }}
            - ${{ compiler('m2w64_fortran') }}
      run_exports:
        strong:
          - if: linux and cgo
            then: __glibc >=${{ c_stdlib_version }}
          - if: osx and cgo
            then: __osx >=12
    tests:
      - files:
          recipe:
            - ${{ go_variant_str }}/
        requirements:
          run:
            - if: unix and cgo
              then: ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - if: win and cgo
              then: ${{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}
        script:
          # telemetry counter files are written asynchronously into $HOME, which
          # races with the test directory cleanup
          - go telemetry off
          - if: unix
            then:
              - ./${{ go_variant_str }}/test.sh
              # etc/conda/env_vars.d/go.json is activated and its baked-in build
              # prefix was rewritten to the installation prefix
              - test "$GOTOOLCHAIN" = "local"
              - test "$GOROOT" = "$CONDA_PREFIX/go"
              - test "$(go env GOROOT)" = "$CONDA_PREFIX/go"
          - if: win
            then:
              - ${{ go_variant_str }}\test.bat
              # etc/conda/env_vars.d/go.json is activated and its baked-in build
              # prefix was rewritten to the installation prefix. The JSON stores
              # forward slashes, so compare slash-insensitively.
              - if not "%GOTOOLCHAIN%"=="local" exit /b 1
              - 'if not "%GOROOT:\=/%"=="%CONDA_PREFIX:\=/%/go" exit /b 1'
              - 'for /f "delims=" %%i in (''go env GOROOT'') do set "GO_GOROOT=%%i"'
              - 'if not "%GO_GOROOT:\=/%"=="%CONDA_PREFIX:\=/%/go" exit /b 1'
    about:
      homepage: https://go.dev/
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: go/LICENSE
      summary: The Go Programming Language

  # meta-package for non-feedstock use
  - package:
      name: go-${{ go_variant_str }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('go', exact=true) }}
        - if: unix and cgo
          then: ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - if: win and cgo
          then: ${{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          # telemetry counter files are written asynchronously into $HOME, which
          # races with the test directory cleanup
          - go telemetry off
          - go help

about:

  license: BSD-3-Clause

  summary: The Go Programming Language (${{ go_variant_str }})
